import unittest
from solution import retitle_panels


class RetitlePanelsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_matching_id_changes_only_title_and_preserves_order(self):
        panels = [
            {"id": 1, "title": "One", "meta": {"colors": ["red"]}},
            {"id": 2, "title": "Two", "enabled": True},
        ]
        result = retitle_panels(panels, 2, "Second")
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"id": 1, "title": "One", "meta": {"colors": ["red"]}},
            {"id": 2, "title": "Second", "enabled": True},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(panels[1]["title"], "Two")

    def test_no_match_returns_unchanged_deep_copy(self):
        panels = [{"id": 1, "title": "One", "meta": {"nested": [[1]]}}]
        result = retitle_panels(panels, 99, "Unused")
        self.assertEqual(result, panels)
        self.assertIsNot(result, panels)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], panels[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["meta"], panels[0]["meta"])
        result[0]["meta"]["nested"][0].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(panels[0]["meta"]["nested"], [[1]])

    def test_empty_input(self):
        panels = []
        result = retitle_panels(panels, 1, "New")
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        self.assertIsNot(result, panels)

    def test_type_errors(self):
        invalid_calls = [
            lambda: retitle_panels((), 1, "x"),
            lambda: retitle_panels([], True, "x"),
            lambda: retitle_panels([], 1, 2),
            lambda: retitle_panels([1], 1, "x"),
            lambda: retitle_panels([{"id": True, "title": "x"}], 1, "x"),
            lambda: retitle_panels([{"id": 1, "title": 2}], 1, "x"),
        ]
        for call in invalid_calls:
            with self.subTest(call=call), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                call()

    def test_value_errors(self):
        invalid_calls = [
            lambda: retitle_panels([], 1, ""),
            lambda: retitle_panels([], 1, "a\nb"),
            lambda: retitle_panels([], 1, "a\rb"),
            lambda: retitle_panels([{"id": 1}], 1, "x"),
            lambda: retitle_panels([{"title": "x"}], 1, "x"),
            lambda: retitle_panels([{"id": 1, "title": "a"}, {"id": 1, "title": "b"}], 1, "x"),
        ]
        for call in invalid_calls:
            with self.subTest(call=call), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                call()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
